metadata.executor: Agent-tool subagents, one per eval, each pointed at a copy of fixtures/<id>/inputs as its working directory, with SKILL.md loaded and no browser, web, calendar, email, or connector access
metadata.notes: Graded against each trial's written report and its final reply. Eval 2, 4, and 6 trials stop to ask the user, as the skill directs, so their expectations are checked against the draft and question in the reply. Eval 6's report was withheld pending the user's choice of 76' or 77'; the draft in the reply was graded. All six with-skill evals were rerun after a real-game test added guidance on hand-started tracker clocks, screenshots inside notes exports, quoting observations, Sprocket's Scorekeeper screen, and Veo kickoff events. Eval 3 (with and without the skill) and eval 1 (with) were rerun after the skill gained the Absent roster label and the coach-message email search, and eval 3's notes gained an absent player; evals 2, 4, 5, and 6 carry over, since those rules do not reach them. Eval 3 was rerun again after absent players' names became struck through. The recording check (reading jersey numbers from video) is not exercised: trials have no recording access.
